finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.untrusted_source: The filename 'fsm.dot' is hard-coded and attacker-controlled
finding.trigger: The attacker can control the filename 'fsm.dot' to inject malicious commands into the file system
finding.assumptions: The filename 'fsm.dot' is not intended to be configurable and is hard-coded, but if it were to be configurable, it could lead to OS command injection

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked the source of the filename argument to fopen. The argument is the string literal "fsm.dot", which is a compile‑time constant and not derived from any user input, environment variable, argv, file, or IPC. Since the source of untrusted data is not present, there is no path from attacker‑controlled data to the fopen call. No trigger can be constructed because the filename is immutable at runtime.
